title: Title and Lien Administration Standard for Auto Loans Paid in Full
content:
## A. Quoting a payoff

A.1 A payoff quote states the amount for a date up to the number of calendar days ahead that the product publishes as the life of a quote, together with the per-diem interest.

A.2 The per-diem interest is the unpaid principal multiplied by the rate recorded on the loan, divided by one hundred and then by the product's day count basis, and rounded half-up to the cent.

## B. Withdrawn bases

B.1 The basis by which the amount required to pay a loan of the Auto Loans line off on a date was measured is **no longer in force**. That amount is settled on the basis now in force.

B.2 The basis by which a loan paid off with waiver coverage in force thereby earned a refund of that coverage is **no longer in force**.

## C. A payment that settles the loan

C.1 A payment of at least the amount required to settle the loan, taken on its credit date, posts as a payoff, pays the charges, the interest and the principal to nothing, and moves the loan to paid off.

C.2 Any excess over that amount is refunded to the payer within 5 business days, by the same method the money arrived by.

C.3 A payment short of that amount leaves the loan open, and is applied in the ordinary order.

## D. Releasing the lien

D.1 The lien release must be sent within the business days after the loan was paid off that the product publishes.

D.2 Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays. They are counted with the first business day after the closing date recorded on the loan as day 1, and the release is due by the business day that ends the count.

D.3 Where the state holds the title electronically, the release is sent electronically to that state's motor vehicle agency. Otherwise the signed title is mailed to the address on file.

## E. Boundary illustration on the release deadline

E.1 On a product publishing 10 business days, a loan closed on a Friday that is a business day has the following Monday as the first business day after closing, which is day 1. The release is due by the business day that is the tenth in that count, Federal Reserve holidays falling inside it being skipped rather than counted.

## F. Point of judgement

F.1 The days a quote remains good and the days within which the release is sent are different clocks: the first runs in calendar days, the second in business days, and neither is read from the other.

superseded_clauses: The payoff amount on a date is principal_balance plus auto_msr_accrued_interest through that date plus fees_due.
A loan that is paid off with GAP coverage in force earns a GAP refund under auto_evt_gap_refund.
